data.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with over 8+ years of experience in designing and delivering scalable, high-performance software solutions.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross−functional teams, mentor junior developers, and drive technical excellence in alignment with business objectives.
Proficient in Java, Microservices Architecture, Spring Boot, and data-driven decision-making with a strong focus on data structures and algorithms for optimized performance.
Adept at agile development practices, sprint planning, and team collaboration, ensuring on- time delivery of complex projects.
Skilled in stakeholder management, strategic planning, and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within teams.

Designed efficient data structures for real-time patient data access and reporting.
Enhanced application usability through API integration and workflow optimization.

raw_sections.skills:
Key Skills
Technical Leadership: Mentoring team members, code reviews, and fostering best practices.
Software Development Expertise: Core Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and RESTful APIs.
Scalable System Design: Proficiency in microservices, Kafka, and asynchronous communication.
Agile Methodologies: Sprint planning, retrospectives, and delivering incremental value.
Team Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to align team goals with business objectives.
Performance Optimization: Expertise in data structures, algorithms, and low-latency solutions.
Technical Skills
Languages: Java, J2EE, JavaScript, JSON, REST APIs.
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate.
Tools: Eclipse, IntelliJ, Kafka, Maven, GIT, VMware vSphere, tortoise.
Databases: Cosmos DB, Postgres, Oracle, NoSql, Cassandra.
Other Skills: Microservices Architecture, Data Structures and Algorithms, CI/CD Automation.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience
Senior Software Engineer | Walmart GTS India	Aug 2021 – Present
Led the design and development of the Stride Order Management System, integrating Kafka, Elasticsearch, and Cosmos DB.
Collaborated with product managers and architects to define project roadmaps and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
Mentored junior engineers, conducted code reviews, and introduced best practices in system design and development.
Introduced performance optimization techniques, reducing API response time by 30%.
Contributed to process improvements, including automation of CI/CD pipelines, resulting in a 20% reduction in deployment time.
Software Engineer II | Hewlett Packard Enterprise	Sep 2017 – Jul 2021
Designed and implemented scalable solutions for HPE Synergy and HPE OneView, focusing on hybrid cloud environments.
Acted as a technical mentor, supporting junior developers in solving complex coding challenges.
Collaborated with QA and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration and testing of features.
Automated test suites and deployment processes, improving release cycles by 25%.
Software Engineer | ICT Health Technology	Apr 2016 – Sep 2017
Developed and maintained the HINAI Patient Management, optimizing patient record retrieval by 40% and developed and delivered backend mobile app code single handedly.
Contributed to team knowledge-sharing sessions, improving overall development practices.
